description: Use this when the user wants SQL pretty-printed or reformatted: one clause per line, optional upper-case keywords and trailing semicolon. Comments are not kept. Returns {formatted_sql, options}.

indent_size.description: Spaces per indent level for nested blocks such as CREATE TABLE columns; clauses always start at column 0. 0 puts each statement on one line (default: 2)

uppercase_keywords.description: true upper-cases all SQL keywords (AND, IN, CASE, ...), but not data type names. false keeps the formatter's casing: clause keywords (SELECT, FROM, WHERE, ...) upper-case, other keywords (e.g. and, or) may keep their input case (default: false)

name: format_sql
